offers_amount_check.name: offers_amount_check
offers_amount_check.value: "offers"."offered_amount" >= 0 AND ("offers"."counter_amount" IS NULL OR "offers"."counter_amount" > 0) AND ("offers"."agreed_amount" IS NULL OR "offers"."agreed_amount" > 0)

orders_amounts_check.name: orders_amounts_check
orders_amounts_check.value:
"orders"."unit_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."item_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."shipping_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."platform_fee" >= 0
        AND "orders"."platform_fee" <= "orders"."item_amount"
        AND ("orders"."paypal_fee" IS NULL OR "orders"."paypal_fee" >= 0)
        AND "orders"."refunded_amount" >= 0 AND "orders"."platform_fee_refunded" >= 0
